alt: 花園桌旁，一名棋手從容坐著，對手看著被包圍的主棋，攤開雙手微笑認輸。
scene_prompt: At a peaceful chess-like strategy board on a garden table, one adult player has placed a clever arrangement of plain unmarked wooden pieces that clearly surrounds the opponent central piece without any pieces knocked down. The opponent raises open empty hands and smiles ruefully in willing concession, while the winner sits composed. Make the easy victory through strategy and peaceful surrender the focus, no blades, blood or physical fighting, simple board without numbers or letters.
